problem_text:
A logistics manager must select cargo containers for shipment. Available containers are:
* Container A: size 7 cubic meters, profit $191
* Container B: size 28 cubic meters, profit $171
* Container C: size 40 cubic meters, profit $114
* Container D: size 36 cubic meters, profit $254
* Container E: size 29 cubic meters, profit $276
The transport vehicle has a maximum capacity of 98 cubic meters. Choose the container combination that yields the highest total profit without exceeding this capacity. Each container is either fully loaded or left behind.
